notes: Transcribed from MileSplit raw result text (me.milesplit.com). Schools kept as MileSplit prints them. Prelim/final/heat rows as printed; points column not copied; exhibition marks (x) flagged. Abbreviated or mascot school names (LAC, MTB, Dragons ...) expanded to full names. Team scores as printed are not reproduced by the standard XC scoring check (the meet scores by division/class, ties or squads); every runner row is complete, schools identified and times in place order (accepted 2026-10-19). Second read 2026-10-28: the first transcription held one list per gender (the fuller of varsity and JV, which the same '5k Run CC' label made collide): JV boys (129) under boys and varsity girls (104). Now all four races: varsity boys 110 (page 333492, combined), JV boys 129 ('5k Run CC JV'), varsity girls 104, JV girls 91 ('5k Run CC JV'); the Division 1/2 pages (333493, 333495, 333494, 333497) are subsets of the combined varsity pages and are not stored twice. Team scores are the combined varsity pages': boys 16 teams and girls 15 teams all reproduce from the places (the earlier boys block was the varsity block attached to the JV race and the girls block was the Division 2 girls page's 6 teams); the JV pages print no team scores. All 434 source rows match name, school and time.
